name: Content Review material usefulness policy
status: user_confirmed; source-independent console assessment implemented; numeric pipeline scoring integration pending

material_identity.verified_paper_and_related_presentation: Keep the paper as the primary research resource, with slides or recording as separately typed supporting assets.

presentation_without_substantive_audio.numeric_deduction: Not yet calibrated; do not invent a numeric score or report this policy as applied by the live scorer.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.user_basis: A deck or presentation without audio is of very limited standalone value to ALEX.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.slides_without_speaker_notes: Record the additional context limitation. Slides and missing notes are not a full research paper.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.notes_alone: Do not waive the audio-related deduction merely because slides or speaker notes exist.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.audio_status_unknown: Hold media verification and mark the deduction provisional; do not claim audio is absent before checking.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.verified_audio_absent: Apply the major resource-usefulness deduction and retain its reason in assessment output.

verification: full or substantively complete presentation rather than teaser or excerpt
working canonical link and access conditions
verified_substantive_recording.effect: Remove the missing-audio deduction only after verification; assess usefulness and quality normally.
verified_substantive_recording.paper_status: Remain typed as a presentation or recording; no inferred paper status or peer review.

evidence_to_record: paper_url and verified format when present
implementation_note: This file records the user's scoring instruction. The scorer and background worker must consume the rule before claiming a numeric deduction has been applied.
scope: All inbound ALEX sources and collections, present and future; not limited to Virus Bulletin.

current_usefulness.scope: All inbound sources and collections, including SOUPS, Virus Bulletin and regular weekly discovery.
current_usefulness.assessment_timing: After all six mechanical preflight gates pass and before substantive recommendation binding/manual admission.
current_usefulness.priority: Present-day usefulness to cybercrime research and investigation takes precedence over historical existence or accumulated citations.

labels.currently_useful: The method, evidence or insight remains applicable; explain its current use and limitations.
labels.foundational_historical: Retains demonstrable foundational or historical value; label that value explicitly and give it lower preparation priority.
labels.superseded: Depends on obsolete conditions and offers little transferable value; recommend exclusion with a concrete content-based reason.

evidence_required: material actually inspected and assessment depth
specific present-day application or historical contribution
obsolete assumptions, dependencies or superseding evidence when applicable
current_usefulness.older_material: Require a stronger explicit explanation of continuing usefulness for older material; distinguish obsolete platform-specific techniques from transferable methods, behavioural findings and investigative principles.
current_usefulness.unknown: If usefulness or supersession cannot be established, record uncertainty and discuss or hold as appropriate; do not infer obsolescence from publication year.
current_usefulness.preserve: Existing scores, hard gates, automatic acceptance, prior decisions and reviewed-content hashes remain in force. No retroactive removal or decision reversal without the existing authenticated decision process.
current_usefulness.implementation_scope: Recorded worker/editorial instructions. No new numerical age penalty, score weight or public UI badge is claimed as implemented.
